Writes docs/SHARED-FACTS.json: the facts, airport rules and official sources behind every place in docs/PLACES.json. It is a copy, never a link: the other website keeps its own copy and builds from it alone, so stopping this export changes nothing there (docs/SEVERANCE.md). Only public, official-source facts go in: no client, broker, operator, supplier or investor data. Run: python3 scripts/export_shared_facts.py
